colombian-andes.overview: The Colombian Andes offer striking high-altitude walking, from the towering wax palms of the Cocora Valley to the high páramo above the cloud forest. Day hikers can explore cloud forests and unique páramo ecosystems, while multi-day treks reach remote alpine lakes and rugged summits. The best conditions align with the two drier windows from December to February and June to August.

months.1: January offers the clearest skies and driest trails for high-altitude páramo treks and day hikes through the Cocora Valley.
months.2: February maintains excellent conditions for exploring the páramo, with firm trails and clear views of the high peaks.
months.10: October is one of the wettest months of the year, making high-altitude treks difficult with deep mud and heavily obscured views.

months.6: Deep snow closes the high routes and most Villarrica climbs. Walking is limited to short, often muddy or snow-covered lower trails between storms.

months.12: Winter sets in fully, with extreme cold and deep snow.

months.7: The valley floor often tops 115°F and can pass 120°F, making hiking there genuinely dangerous; the only safe walking is the high-altitude Telescope Peak trail.
months.8: The valley floor often tops 115°F and can pass 120°F, making hiking there genuinely dangerous; the only safe walking is the high-altitude Telescope Peak trail.

months.7: Summer heat dominates, with temperatures in the upper 80s and sometimes above 90 degrees. Walking is best limited to early morning coastal strolls or shaded forest paths to avoid the intense midday sun.

egypt.overview: Hiking here centers on the rugged desert mountains of the Sinai Peninsula. The most famous route is the steep climb up Mount Sinai, often walked before dawn to watch the sunrise over the jagged peaks. A local Bedouin guide is required for the ascent, which begins at the monastery car park. Beyond the high peaks, shorter walks explore narrow desert gorges like the Colored Canyon, reached by 4x4 with a guide.

months.4: The mild spring weather continues, making this an ideal time for easy loops through the coastal forests and marshes.
